# Fixseo — SEO Audit & Digital Growth Agency

## About
Fixseo is an automated SEO audit service that delivers a complete website audit report in 5 seconds.

## Services
- Free AI Visibility Check (free)
- Full SEO Audit + Quick Fix Guide (£19.99)
- Quick Fix Guide (£9.99)
- PageForge — Landing Page Builder (£19.99+)
- VicMailer — Email Outreach System (£9/month+)
